name: CircleCI MCP
description: Lets coding agents diagnose CircleCI pipelines over a hosted MCP server, reading runs, job logs, and failing tests, and rerunning or cancelling workflows.

skills.name: Failed Run Diagnosis
skills.description: Chains list_runs, get_run, list_workflows, and get_job_logs to find a failed job and read its failed step output.

skills.name: Workflow Rerun And Cancel
skills.description: Reruns a workflow from the start or only from failed jobs with from_failed, or cancels a running workflow by UUID.

skills.name: Failing Test Lookup
skills.description: Lists a job's test results with list_job_tests, returning failing tests by default along with their failure messages.

skills.name: Usage Data Export
skills.description: Exports an organization's CircleCI usage data as downloadable CSV files for a date range of up to 31 days.

skills.name: CLI MCP
skills.description: Runs the CircleCI CLI's built-in MCP locally for config authoring, orb management, and other administrative commands.
